info.description: Authenticated fixed operations for the official canvas CLI and privately configured studio web session. The runtime capabilities endpoint declares enabled operations, current write policy, and credit policy; the separate studio catalog maps feature coverage and acceptance evidence; it is not a dispatch table.

servers.description: Local authenticated HTTP backend. The local launcher configures its port and MCP transport.

oneOf.title: resource.upload
oneOf.description: Media bytes use bounded base64 chunks with SHA-256, or opaque managed upload/artifact IDs. No caller-supplied paths or URLs. Uploads use stable resource IDs. Downloads support successful images through the CLI and successful MP4 video or MP3 audio through an authenticated fixed resource read and credential-free allowlisted CDN fetch. Other audio encodings are not enabled.

oneOf.description: Preflight or one submission for an already prepared canonical extension draft. Defaults to a successful 1080p final source, ordinary seedance_2.5 and five-second extension. Does not create/edit a target draft. Live requires exact saved prompt, expectedDraftVersion, allowOrdinaryModel and an unlimited service budget.

expectedDraftVersion.description: Canonical version observed after preparing the target. Required for live submission; a newer head requires another read/review.

allowOrdinaryModel.description: Explicit per-call acknowledgement: this is ordinary video extension, not official sample generation.

allowSampleSource.description: Explicit per-call exception only; normal workflow promotes the sample to 1080p first.

oneOf.description: Read an existing mode-9 extension using its original identities. Never submits or retries generation.

Copy the live personal subject's images and optional saved voice into a NEW element. Original subject unchanged. No generation. A single voice defaults to index 0; multiple voices require voiceIndex. Default dryRun=true.
Read only the original import journal's exact planned node/resources and verify bindings and description hash. No upload, creation or generation. Do not modify the journal.

Read only the original import journal's exact planned node/resources and verify bindings and description hash. No upload, creation or generation. Append a separate local reconciliation receipt; preserve the original import result.

Create one new personal image subject by copying existing same-account material. Name required. Source retained. Voices excluded unless includeVoices=true. Default dryRun=true. Version check is preflight only; the platform provides no atomic conditional update here.

Update only name and/or description; preserve all existing material bindings. Requires the current data_id. Default dryRun=true. Version check is preflight only; the platform provides no atomic conditional update here.

confirmPermanentDelete.description: Caller attests that a human explicitly authorized permanent deletion of this exact subject. Setting true does not obtain or substitute for that authorization.

oneOf.description: Permanently delete exactly one personal subject. Not archive; no restoration contract established. Live execution additionally requires prior human authorization for this exact object, confirmPermanentDelete=true as the caller's attestation, and current deletable=true. A preserved local before-state is not proof of recoverability. Default dryRun=true. Version check is preflight only; the platform provides no atomic conditional update here.

Append one saved same-account voice binding. Does not create or generate audio. Rejects duplicate vids. Default dryRun=true. Version check is preflight only; the platform provides no atomic conditional update here.

Replace one saved voice binding from another current owned subject. Selection follows a replaced selected voice; select=true explicitly selects the replacement. Default dryRun=true. Version check is preflight only; the platform provides no atomic conditional update here.

Detach one voice binding, preserving media and the private before-state journal. This is not remote media archive/deletion. No automatic restore is claimed. Default dryRun=true. Version check is preflight only; the platform provides no atomic conditional update here.
